"""Reviewed, protected correctness recipe for the local fixture."""
import unittest
from app import response_for_path


class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_root_status(self):
        self.assertEqual(response_for_path('/')[0], 200)

    def test_root_body(self):
        self.assertEqual(response_for_path('/')[1], b'ok\n')

    def test_missing(self):
        self.assertEqual(response_for_path('/other'), (404, b'missing\n'))
